kit_page.name: tron_kit
kit_page.summary: Tron world: grid, circuit traces, neon rim, light-cycle trails, and the dark grade. Off is byte-identical.

kit_row.help: Master switch for the Tron package. HDR only; off leaves the frame untouched.
kit_row.label: Enable Tron

kit_row.help: Camera (default) grades after metering and before bloom. Scene is hazed and metered.
kit_row.label: Layer

kit_row.help: Named colour palette. Picking one writes the four swatches below; Custom keeps them as they are.
kit_row.label: Palette

kit_row.help: Main palette colour for grid, traces, rim and trails. Editing it sets Palette to Custom.
kit_row.label: Primary

kit_row.help: Second palette colour, used by the sea mode and colour options. Editing it sets Palette to Custom.
kit_row.label: Secondary

kit_row.help: Major grid lines and pads mix toward this. Also a Rig Rim colour source.
kit_row.label: Accent

kit_row.help: Colour of the travelling grid pulses in palette mode.
kit_row.label: Pulse

kit_row.help: Picking a Tron look also applies its linked Roto Ink preset.
kit_row.label: + Roto Ink

kit_row.help: Picking a Tron look also applies its linked Rig Rim preset.
kit_row.label: + Rig Rim

kit_row.help: Applies the Roto Ink preset linked to the last Tron look, even if '+ Roto Ink' is off.
kit_row.label: Roto preset

kit_row.help: Applies the Rig Rim preset linked to the last Tron look, even if '+ Rig Rim' is off.
kit_row.label: Rim preset

kit_row.help: Sets every Tron setting back to its default, which turns Tron off.
kit_row.label: Reset all

kit_row.help: Shared Tron clock rate. 1 is real time.
kit_row.label: Speed

kit_row.help: Freezes the shared Tron clock: grid and pulse phases stop advancing.
kit_row.label: Pause

kit_row.help: Frequency of the shared pulse. It drives the rim tint, Tron Suit and neon pulses.
kit_row.label: Pulse Hz

kit_row.help: Shape of the shared pulse waveform.
kit_row.label: Pulse shape

kit_row.help: Depth of the shared pulse on the rim tint and neon rim.
kit_row.label: Pulse amount

kit_row.help: Drives Roto Ink's animation phase from this Tron clock, instead of its own.
kit_row.label: Sync Roto Ink

kit_row.help: Also scales the Tron clock by the Director camera's Time speed.
kit_row.label: Director time

kit_row.help: How strongly the dark grade applies. 0 is grade off.
kit_row.label: Strength

kit_row.help: How far the scene darkens, in stops.
kit_row.label: Darken EV

kit_row.help: Removes colour from the dark grade. 1 is black and white.
kit_row.label: Desaturate

kit_row.help: Black lift in exposed units. Higher keeps the blacks from going dead.
kit_row.label: Crush

kit_row.help: 0 turns the sky black at full grade strength; 1 leaves the sky untouched.
kit_row.label: Sky darken

kit_row.help: Tint colour of the dark grade. Normalised before use.
kit_row.label: Grade tint

kit_row.help: How much the grade tint applies.
kit_row.label: Tint amount

kit_row.help: Low edge of the keep-bright range, in exposed luminance. Neon above this survives the grade.
kit_row.label: Keep bright lo

kit_row.help: High edge of the keep-bright range, in exposed luminance.
kit_row.label: Keep bright hi

kit_row.help: How much the isolated subject is spared from the grade.
kit_row.label: Keep subject

kit_row.help: World-space neon grid on every surface.
kit_row.label: Enable grid

kit_row.help: Grid line brightness. Display-linear, so it does not follow exposure.
kit_row.label: Intensity

kit_row.help: Distance between grid lines, in metres.
kit_row.label: Spacing m

kit_row.help: Full width of a grid line, in metres.
kit_row.label: Width m

kit_row.help: Grid glow into bloom. The main bloom control for the neon, and stable with exposure.
kit_row.label: Glow feed

kit_row.help: Minimum on-screen line width in pixels at 1080p.
kit_row.label: Min width px

kit_row.help: Draw a major line every N minor lines. 0 or 1 means no major lines.
kit_row.label: Major every

kit_row.help: Major line width multiplier.
kit_row.label: Major width x

kit_row.help: Major line intensity multiplier.
kit_row.label: Major int x

kit_row.help: Grid weight on floor-facing surfaces.
kit_row.label: Floor

kit_row.help: Grid weight on wall-facing surfaces.
kit_row.label: Wall

kit_row.help: Grid weight on ceiling-facing surfaces.
kit_row.label: Ceiling

kit_row.help: Triplanar blend sharpness.
kit_row.label: Sharpness

kit_row.help: Geometric avoids normal-map speckle in the grid lines.
kit_row.label: Normal source

kit_row.help: Distance at which the grid fades out, in metres. 0 means no fade.
kit_row.label: Far fade m

kit_row.help: Grid behaviour at the water surface. Has no effect on the Scene layer.
kit_row.label: Water mode

kit_row.help: Tolerance for detecting the water surface height, in metres.
kit_row.label: Water tol m

kit_row.help: How much the isolated subject keeps the grid off it.
kit_row.label: Subject excl

kit_row.help: Draw the grid only within this many metres of a subject. 0 means the whole world.
kit_row.label: Subject radius

kit_row.help: Feather of the subject-radius falloff, in metres.
kit_row.label: Radius feather

kit_row.help: Sets the grid and pulse lattice origin to the camera position.
kit_row.label: Origin

kit_row.help: Clears the lattice origin back to (0, 0, 0).
kit_row.label: Origin clear

kit_row.help: Brightness of the travelling pulses, as a multiple of grid intensity. 0 is off.
kit_row.label: Amount

kit_row.help: Travel speed of the pulses, in metres per second. Negative reverses travel.
kit_row.label: Speed m/s

kit_row.help: Length of each pulse, as a fraction of its wavelength.
kit_row.label: Length

kit_row.help: Distance between pulses, in metres.
kit_row.label: Wavelength m

kit_row.help: Fraction of grid lines that carry a pulse.
kit_row.label: Density

kit_row.help: Which way the pulses travel.
kit_row.label: Direction

kit_row.help: Colour of the pulses: palette pulse, secondary, or white.
kit_row.label: Pulse colour

kit_row.help: Reshuffles which lines pulse.
kit_row.label: Seed

kit_row.help: Circuit-board traces on walls, on the same lattice as the grid.
kit_row.label: Enable traces

kit_row.help: Trace brightness. Display-linear, so it does not follow exposure.
kit_row.label: Intensity

kit_row.help: Fraction of cells that carry a trace.
kit_row.label: Density

kit_row.help: Trace cell size in metres. Each cell gets one hashed trace variant.
kit_row.label: Cell m

kit_row.help: Trace full width in metres. Never thinner than the grid's minimum width.
kit_row.label: Width m

kit_row.help: Via and pad radius at bends, in metres. 0 means none.
kit_row.label: Pad radius m

kit_row.help: Chance a diagonal cell survives. Otherwise it becomes straight.
kit_row.label: Diagonal

kit_row.help: Trace weight on wall-facing surfaces.
kit_row.label: Walls

kit_row.help: Trace weight on flat surfaces. 0 leaves the floor to the grid.
kit_row.label: Floors

kit_row.help: Brightness of the travelling trace pulse, as a multiple of trace intensity. 0 is off.
kit_row.label: Pulse amt

kit_row.help: Travel speed of the trace pulse, in cells per second. Negative reverses.
kit_row.label: Pulse cells/s

kit_row.help: Tail length of the trace pulse, as a fraction of a cell.
kit_row.label: Pulse length

kit_row.help: Reshuffles which cells carry a trace.
kit_row.label: Seed

kit_row.help: Neon rim on the subject mask. Mask based, so a little can leak onto a wall behind.
kit_row.label: Enable rim

kit_row.help: Brightness of the neon rim. Display-linear, so it does not follow exposure.
kit_row.label: Gain

kit_row.help: Fresnel exponent. Lower is a wider rim.
kit_row.label: Exponent

kit_row.help: Vertical scan band that sweeps the target's box. 0 is off.
kit_row.label: Scan amt

kit_row.help: Speed of the scan band, in sweeps per second.
kit_row.label: Scan /s

kit_row.help: Width of the scan band, as a fraction of the target's screen height.
kit_row.label: Scan width

kit_row.help: Outline gain where the Fresnel term is weak on camera-facing surfaces.
kit_row.label: Silhouette

kit_row.help: Relative depth step that counts as a silhouette for the rim.
kit_row.label: Sil threshold

kit_row.help: Depth of the shared pulse applied to the neon rim.
kit_row.label: Rim pulse

kit_row.help: Primary, per target (by palette index), or secondary.
kit_row.label: Colour mode

kit_row.help: Keeps the neon rim off horizontal surfaces, such as the floor in the target box.
kit_row.label: Reject floors

kit_row.help: Actor FX Tron Suit uses the palette primary while Tron is on. Off uses the cast member's own hue.
kit_row.label: Use palette

kit_row.help: Seam brightness multiplier. 0 leaves only the rim.
kit_row.label: Seam gain

kit_row.help: Suit rim brightness multiplier. 0 leaves only the seams.
kit_row.label: Suit rim

kit_row.help: Seam cell size in the avatar's bind frame, in metres.
kit_row.label: Seam cell m

kit_row.help: Full width of each seam, in metres.
kit_row.label: Seam width m

kit_row.help: Fraction of body cells that carry a seam.
kit_row.label: Seam density

kit_row.help: Light-cycle trails behind moving actors. Drawn at the Camera layer; not graded; blooms.
kit_row.label: Enable trails

kit_row.help: Vertical light wall, flat ground streak, or a camera-facing ribbon.
kit_row.label: Style

kit_row.help: Which actors lay trails. Off-screen actors keep laying trail.
kit_row.label: Target set

kit_row.help: Trail brightness. HDR and display-linear, so it does not follow exposure.
kit_row.label: Intensity

kit_row.help: Wall height, or camera-ribbon centre height, in metres. Scales with the avatar.
kit_row.label: Height m

kit_row.help: Ground streak or camera ribbon width, in metres. Scales with the avatar.
kit_row.label: Width m

kit_row.help: Age in seconds at which a trail point is gone. Pause freezes it; Director speed scales it.
kit_row.label: Fade time s

kit_row.help: Primary, per-actor palette index, or secondary.
kit_row.label: Colour mode

kit_row.help: Nearest N candidates that can lay trails. Others age out.
kit_row.label: Max actors

kit_row.help: Scales height and width by the actor's bounding height.
kit_row.label: Scale avatar

kit_row.help: Base lift above the feet, in metres. Avoids floor z-fight.
kit_row.label: Lift m

kit_row.help: Fade exponent. Above 1 gives a long dim tail.
kit_row.label: Fade curve

kit_row.help: Width of the bright top cap or core line, as a fraction of the ribbon.
kit_row.label: Edge / core

kit_row.help: Brightness multiple of the cap or core.
kit_row.label: Edge gain

kit_row.help: Brightness of the translucent body.
kit_row.label: Body gain

kit_row.help: Glow feed into bloom. Stable with exposure.
kit_row.label: Glow

kit_row.help: Analytic distance fade toward black, or none.
kit_row.label: Fog

kit_row.help: Trail fog density, per metre.
kit_row.label: Fog density

kit_row.help: Minimum distance between stored trail points, in metres.
kit_row.label: Spacing m

kit_row.help: Below this speed no points are laid.
kit_row.label: Min speed m/s

kit_row.help: Seconds below the minimum speed before a segment breaks.
kit_row.label: Idle break s

kit_row.help: A jump larger than this, such as a teleport, starts a new segment.
kit_row.label: Break dist m

kit_row.help: Stored points per actor. The oldest segment is trimmed first.
kit_row.label: Max points

kit_row.help: Stored segments per actor.
kit_row.label: Max segments

kit_row.help: Clears all trails on every Director cut. Eased transitions and rewinds also count as cuts.
kit_row.label: Clear on cut

kit_row.help: Drops every stored trail point now.
kit_row.label: Clear trails

kit_row.help: Which actors or objects feed the subject mask and grid anchors. Same list as Roto Ink.
kit_row.label: Target set

kit_row.help: The subject used when Target set is Single Director subject.
kit_row.label: Single subj

kit_row.help: Maximum number of subject targets gathered.
kit_row.label: Max targets

kit_row.help: Shape of the subject mask box.
kit_row.label: Shape

kit_row.help: Edge feather of the subject box, as a fraction of its radius.
kit_row.label: Feather

kit_row.help: Depth slab pad of the subject mask, in metres.
kit_row.label: Depth range m

kit_row.help: Subject mask box scale multiplier.
kit_row.label: Box scale

kit_row.help: Subject mask source for the grid. Avatar tag needs the Enable avatar tag button in Infrared.
kit_row.label: Mask (grid)

kit_row.help: Subject mask source for the neon rim. Avatar tag needs the Enable avatar tag button in Infrared.
kit_row.label: Mask (rim)

kit_row.help: Inverts the subject mask.
kit_row.label: Invert

kit_row.help: Neon scale on frames the colour pipeline will not expose or tonemap, such as a no-post snapshot.
kit_row.label: No-post scale

kit_row.help: Bloom-metering feedback scale while Tron runs at the Camera layer.
kit_row.label: Bloom meter

kit_row.help: Rim tint lives on Light › Rim.
kit_row.label: Rig Rim tint

kit_row.help: Roto Ink's ink line settings are on the Roto Ink page.
kit_row.label: Roto Ink

kit_row.help: Opens the full Lightbox Tron tab.
kit_row.label: Lightbox ›
